Former UP minister dies after falling from 7th floor of MLA residence

Former Uttar Pradesh minister Nanak Ram Bhurji died after falling from the seventh floor of an MLA residence in Lucknow. Police have ruled out foul play in the incident. Bhurji, a former minister and BJP leader, was found dead at the residence. Reports indicate he did not have a room allotted at the complex.
